Time-series lab

ATS workflow, one series at a time

Stationarity: price level vs log return

Closing level

Daily log return

Augmented Dickey-Fuller test on the full sample. The level wanders (unit root not rejected), the log return is stationary, so every model below works on log returns.

Distribution of returns

Excess kurtosis well above 0 means fat tails: big days happen far more often than a normal distribution allows. That is why the GARCH models below use Student-t errors.

Autocorrelation

ACF of returns

PACF of returns

ACF of squared returns

Dashed lines are the 95% band (±1.96/√n). Returns barely correlate with their own past; squared returns do, for many lags. Direction is hard to predict, size of moves is not: volatility clusters.

GARCH(1,1) with Student-t errors

Walk-forward GARCH volatility (annualized) and absolute daily moves

The volatility line is refit every 63 trading days on past data only, so there is no lookahead. This series is one of the agent's 15 features per sector and sets the inverse-volatility anchor.

Forecast check: 21-day ARMA-GARCH bands vs what happened

At every monthly rebalance date in 2021–2025 an AR(1)-GARCH(1,1)-t model is refit on data up to that day and gives an 80% range for the next 21 trading days. Dots are the actual outcome.

Target 80%

Does GARCH predict next-month volatility better?

Average over the 8 tradable sectors, validation and test dates. GARCH is about as good as a plain trailing window, so it is a sound risk input but no secret edge.

Risk outlook for the next two months

Pick a rebalance date and an allocation. Sector forecasts from walk-forward AR(1)-GARCH(1,1)-t fits are combined with a trailing 126-day correlation matrix to give the likely range of ₹1,00,000 over the next 42 trading days. This forecasts risk, not direction.

How often was the range right?

This allocation, every month in 2023–2025

A well-calibrated 80% range should contain the 21-day outcome about 80% of the time. Much higher means the range is too cautious; much lower means it underestimates risk.

Live model service

checking…

Everything on this tab is computed by the server when you press the button: the five trained PPO agents are run on that day's features, and a fresh AR(1)-GARCH(1,1)-t model is fitted on the history up to that day. Nothing here is replayed from a file.
